note: Qur'anic quotations are NOT translated by hand. Every quote in an English or German string is a placeholder token — {{quran:96:1}} — that the build replaces with the wording of the published edition named below. This is the single place a verse rendering exists; changing the edition here changes it everywhere. The Arabic files keep the Qur'anic text itself, which is not a translation and is left exactly as written.

en.title: The Meaning of the Glorious Koran
en.licenseNote: Published 1930; in the public domain. No permission or fee required, which is why it was chosen over more modern renderings that are still in copyright.

96:1.en: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth
96:1.de: Lies im Namen deines Herrn, Der erschaffen hat

5:3.en: This day have I perfected your religion for you…
5:3.de: Heute habe Ich euch eure Religion vervollkommnet…

19:56.en: Lo! he was a saint, a prophet
19:56.de: Er war ein Wahrhaftiger und Prophet

19:54.en: he was a keeper of his promise
19:54.de: er war wahrhaftig in seinem Versprechen

48:1.usageNote: Used descriptively in event 78 rather than as a bracketed quotation, so it renders as an emphasised phrase with a reference, not as a framed verse.

11:1-2.ar: ﴿الر كِتٰبٌ أُحكِمَت ءايٰتُهُ ثُمَّ فُصِّلَت مِن لَدُن حَكيمٍ خَبيرٍ۝أَلّا تَعبُدوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنَّنى لَكُم مِنهُ نَذيرٌ وَبَشيرٌ﴾
11:1-2.en: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed, (Saying): Serve none but Allah. Lo! I am unto you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings.
11:1-2.de: Alif-Lam-Ra. (Dies ist) ein Buch, dessen Zeichen eindeutig festgefügt und hierauf ausführlich dargelegt sind von Seiten eines Allweisen und Allkundigen: Ihr sollt nur Allah dienen. Gewiß, ich bin euch von Ihm (aus) ein Warner und Frohbote.
11:1-2.usageNote: Two consecutive verses quoted as one span in the Arabic source, so they are registered and rendered as one quotation with a single 11:1-2 citation.
